node: Frozen potato products and high-margin signature sides for QSR chains
summary: Layer 1B expanded the public-market universe around frozen potato products and signature fried sides. The most direct US-listed reference asset is Lamb Weston, because its filings identify it as a frozen potato producer with material QSR exposure and McDonald's customer concentration. The underfollowed lane points to enabling chokepoints around industrial food-processing equipment, restaurant fry/frozen-side equipment, and smaller frozen/private-label vegetable processors. Evidence quality is strongest for Lamb Weston and equipment exposure, weaker for small-cap packaged/frozen vegetable names where QSR fry exposure must be verified.
